name: Calix
description: A planeswalker artificially created on Theros to keep Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld; his Spark ignited when he failed.

description_citations.text: "Calix". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, empowered by Ashiok, escapes the Underworld to assassinate Heliod.
timeline.quote: Elspeth became empowered by Ashiok , who equipped her with a weapon created from her past traumas

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth planeswalks away with Calix, whose spark ignites.
timeline.quote: Elspeth planeswalked away, with Calix, whose spark ignited in the meantime, following her.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys weaves Calix to pursue Elspeth; Elspeth defeats him repeatedly on her way to the exit.
timeline.quote: So Klothys weaved her masterpiece: an agent of fate she called Calix .

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a brief reunion with Daxos Elspeth planeswalks away, and Calix sparks and planeswalks after her.
timeline.quote: a spark flared inside him, and he planeswalked after her

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys, livid at souls reversing their deaths, dispatches Agents of Fate and creates Calix to deal with Elspeth's soul.
timeline.quote: For this task, Klothys created Calix .

citation.text: "Klothys", section "Return to the mortal world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The God of Destiny artificially creates Calix on Theros to keep Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Calix was artificially created by the God of Destiny on the plane of Theros to prevent Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.

citation.text: "Calix". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Calix fails in his duty and his fated purpose ignites his Spark, letting him pursue Elspeth across the multiverse.
timeline.quote: When Calix failed in his duty, his fated purpose ignited his Spark, allowing him to pursue Elspeth across the multiverse.

citation.text: "Calix". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "Calix". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: She wove him as an agent of fate.
relations.quote: Created solely to carry out the will of Klothys, Calix pursued Elspeth to preserve that which should be.
